Batch 5 authoring is complete. I added 11 A-page items and 4 examples, corrected the Hermite and Bernstein proofs, and aligned the proof contracts with the final step numbering.

The scoped checks pass: precheck, strict proof contracts, proof layout (39 steps, no defects), rendering, content policy, coverage (19 harvested results, no warnings), focused dependency checks, and source verification (4 unique sources, all 8 coverage entries verified).

**Readiness remains escalated.** The required APP-SPLINE page now exists, but its knot-refinement proof asserts three coefficient identities without deriving them in step 2.1 of `lem-b-spline-basis-refinement-under-single-knot-insertion`; `thm-single-new-knot-insertion-preserves-b-spline-curve` depends on that lemma. APP-SPLINE also records an unresolved floating-point tridiagonal solve interface. The batch-5 cross-page edge remains open, and all 15 items are escalated.

The final proof corrections came after those escalation records were written. The CLI refused to overwrite them without owner rights, so I left them escalated as instructed; their stored hashes predate those corrections, though the final scoped checks pass.

Run-wide checks remain blocked by unfinished inventories, a stale level for `ex-ewald-source-collision-field-singularity`, and malformed YAML at line 21 of `items/lem-ewald-gaussian-poisson-periodization.md`. The live run also remains under an owner repair hold.
